name: Financial Instrument Stipulations 4
definition: Additional restrictions on the financial instrument, related to the stipulation.

Geographics.name: Geographics
Geographics.definition: Type of stipulation expressing geographical constraints on a fixed income instrument. It is expressed with a state or country abbreviation and a minimum or maximum percentage. Example: CA 0-80 (minimum of 80 percent in Californian assests).

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.definition: Range of assessment of securities credit and investment risk.

CouponRange.name: Coupon Range
CouponRange.definition: Identification of a range of coupon numbers attached to its related financial instrument.

AmortisableIndicator.name: Amortisable Indicator
AmortisableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument repays the principal amount in parts during the life cycle of the security.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Reason for which money is raised through the issuance of a security.

AlternativeMinimumTaxIndicator.name: Alternative Minimum Tax Indicator
AlternativeMinimumTaxIndicator.definition: Identifies whether the issue is subject to alternative minimum taxation (used for municipal bonds).

AutoReinvestment.name: Auto Reinvestment
AutoReinvestment.definition: Indicates an instruction to reinvest dividends in the underlying security (or proceeds at maturity in a similar instrument) if the current rate is <rate> or better.

TransactionConditions.name: Transaction Conditions
TransactionConditions.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

CustomDate.name: Custom Date
CustomDate.definition: Indicates an instruction to override an investment's default start and/or end date with a custom date.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

InsuredIndicator.name: Insured Indicator
InsuredIndicator.definition: Identifies whether the lender is assured partial or full payment by a third party if the borrower defaults.

LookBack.name: Look Back
LookBack.definition: Indicates an instruction or attribute giving the number of days to be included in the look-back period for the investment. E.g. some options allow exercise based on the underlying asset's optimal value over the look-back period.

MinimumDenomination.name: Minimum Denomination
MinimumDenomination.definition: Indicates the minimum denomination of a security.

MaximumSubstitution.name: Maximum Substitution
MaximumSubstitution.definition: Maximum number of time the collateral can be substitute.

MinimumIncrement.name: Minimum Increment
MinimumIncrement.definition: Indicates the minimum tradable increments of a security.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Indicates the periodic or regular cycle of interest payments.

MinimumQuantity.name: Minimum Quantity
MinimumQuantity.definition: Indicates the minimum tradable quantity of a security.

Production.name: Production
Production.definition: Indicates a search criterion used when looking to buy a bond, particularly an MBS, issued in a particular year.

RestrictedIndicator.name: Restricted Indicator
RestrictedIndicator.definition: Identifies if the securities is restricted or not (as per Rule 144).

PriceFrequency.name: Price Frequency
PriceFrequency.definition: Indicates the frequency at which the bond is re-rated and therefore re-priced (bond attribute, particularly of floating rate and index linked instruments).

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Indicates the market sector the security is classified as. E.g. pharmacuticals, automobile, housing, etc.

SubstitutionFrequency.name: Substitution Frequency
SubstitutionFrequency.definition: Indicates the maximum number of times collateral can be substituted.

SubstitutionLeft.name: Substitution Left
SubstitutionLeft.definition: Number of remaining times the collateral can be substitute.

WholePoolIndicator.name: Whole Pool Indicator
WholePoolIndicator.definition: Indicates a search criterion when looking to buy an MBS that either is [yes] or is not [no] an entire pool.

PriceSource.name: Price Source
PriceSource.definition: Identifies the Benchmark source price (eg. BB Generic, BB Fairvalue, Brokertec.).

ExpirationDate.name: Expiration Date
ExpirationDate.definition: Date/time at which an interest bearing security becomes due and assets are to be repaid.

OverAllotmentAmount.name: Over Allotment Amount
OverAllotmentAmount.definition: Amount for which a security can be overalloted (as in greenshoe option).

OverAllotmentRate.name: Over Allotment Rate
OverAllotmentRate.definition: Percentage for which a security can be overalloted (as in greenshoe option).

PriceRange.name: Price Range
PriceRange.definition: Indicates a search criterion used when looking to buy a bond within a particular price range.

CallableIndicator.name: Callable Indicator
CallableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the issuer has the right to pay the security prior to maturity. Also called RetractableIndicator.

ConvertibleIndicator.name: Convertible Indicator
ConvertibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest bearing security is convertible into another type of security.

PutableIndicator.name: Putable Indicator
PutableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity. Also called RedeemableIndicator.

PreFundedIndicator.name: Pre Funded Indicator
PreFundedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an interest bearing instrument is deposited in a fund that will be used to pay debt service on refunded securities.

EscrowedIndicator.name: Escrowed Indicator
EscrowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an interest bearing instrument is being escrowed or collateralized either by direct obligations guaranteed by the US government, or by other types of securities. The maturity schedules of the securities in the escrow fund are determined in such a way to pay the maturity value, coupon, and premium payments (if any) of the refunded bonds.

PerpetualIndicator.name: Perpetual Indicator
PerpetualIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security has no maturity date.
